title: Can lies be faked? Comparing low-stakes and high-stakes deception video datasets from a Machine Learning perspective
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of deception detection using machine learning, comparing different video datasets and their performance. While deception itself has ethical implications, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethical principles, moral reasoning, or faith as part of its core research. It briefly mentions ethical challenges in dataset creation but this is not the primary focus.
